title: Estimation of reliability and accuracy of models of $\varphi$-sub-Gaussian process using generating functions of polynomial expansions
summary: Stochastic processes are often represented through orthonormal series expansions, a framework originating in the classical works of Loève and Karhunen and widely used for simulation and numerical approximation. While truncation error in such expansions has been extensively studied, practical models frequently involve an additional source of error arising from the approximation of coefficient functions when closed-form expressions are unavailable. The combined effect of these two errors remains insufficiently addressed in the literature. Building on the author's earlier work on reliability…
